name: Contract LIFF login-loop recovery
scope: Preserve LINE OAuth callback query parameters until LIFF initialization completes
Remove the fragment-only signing token without removing the OAuth callback
Stop automatic LINE Login after one unsuccessful redirect per fresh link open
Keep verified non-signing group members in read-only mode without repeated login

dataIsolation.guard: The signing token remains fragment-only and is never added to a query string, log, page body, or external redirect.

definitionOfDone: The page does not delete LINE OAuth callback query parameters before liff.init()
OAuth callback parameters are removed after LIFF restores authentication
An unsuccessful login callback cannot trigger an unbounded LINE Login loop
A fresh group-link open resets the one-attempt guard
Verified non-signing group members retain read-only access
The signing token is never placed in a query string
